name: Voxel Visualization Ray Marcher
definition: A fragment shader that ray marches through a 3D texture to visualize voxelized data by accumulating color along a ray until opacity saturates or the ray exits the volume.
summary: A fragment shader technique that ray marches through a 3D texture using a fixed-step traversal loop with explicit alpha compositing, rather than relying on pre-filtered screen-space accumulation.
